skill.name: dropshipping-product-research
skill.description: Research dropshipping products and stores using TikTok and Facebook ad signals, product detail, and store intelligence from PipiAds.
skill.summary: Compare dropshipping products, ad creatives, and competing stores using PipiAds data from TikTok and Facebook.
skill.author: pipiads-dev

security_audit.summary: The skill uses Markdown to name MCP tools, not shell commands, and the flagged reconnaissance text describes market research. The setup passes an API key to an external MCP package and points to a separate billing domain that the reviewed file does not verify. The skill declares a global npm install and documents billable requests without a budget limit.

remediation.issue: The API key is passed to an external server package whose code is not included in the reviewed skill.
remediation.suggestion: Review the pinned package and its dependencies before passing a dedicated, minimally scoped API key through the client secret store.

remediation.issue: The key and billing link uses a different domain from the declared homepage.
remediation.suggestion: Link to the key and billing portal from the verified PipiAds homepage, and explain the relationship between the domains.

remediation.issue: The setup declares a global npm install for the external MCP package.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit approval for installation and prefer a user-scoped, isolated setup using a reviewed package version and dependencies.

remediation.issue: The workflow does not define a credit budget for billable searches or detail requests.
remediation.suggestion: Agree on a credit limit, cap search results and detail requests, and ask before making calls that would exceed the limit.

content.value_statement: Paid ads can reveal products worth researching, but ad activity alone tells you little about sales. Use PipiAds to compare product listings, ads, and competing stores before choosing what to investigate.
actual_capabilities: Search ads and product listings for a specific niche, including products indexed in the ad library.
Retrieve ad and product details to compare creatives, listed prices, and landing pages where available.
Look up advertisers and stores to see who is promoting products in a niche.
Compare store competition and product activity using PipiAds store analysis data.
Review store ad schedules and identify frequently used or long-running ads.
limitations: Live research requires a configured PipiAds MCP connection and an API key.
Search results and some detail requests consume PipiAds account credits.
Ad activity does not verify sales, profit margins, or whether an ad is profitable.
The workflow does not cover ongoing monitoring, TikTok Shop analytics, or organic TikTok discovery.

use_cases.title: Shortlist products for a new store
use_cases.description: Use paid ads and product listings to identify candidates and decide which product pages to inspect first.

use_cases.title: Compare creative approaches
use_cases.description: Compare how advertisers show a product, frame its offer, and connect the ad to a landing page.

use_cases.title: Assess competition in a niche
use_cases.description: Compare store activity and ad run lengths to distinguish recurring competition from isolated campaigns.

prompt_templates.title: Find a few product ideas
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: Start with a single niche.
prompt_templates.prompt: Search PipiAds for travel packing cubes. Return up to five products and explain the paid ad signal behind each result. Do not request product details yet.

prompt_templates.title: Compare offers and landing pages
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Assess two listings from a shortlist.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the two product IDs I provide to compare listed prices, offer terms, and landing pages. Mark any details that PipiAds does not show.

prompt_templates.title: Review a competing store
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Check whether an advertised offer appears repeatedly.
prompt_templates.prompt: Look up the store domain I provide and review its longest-running and most-used ads. Summarize repeated creative themes and separate observations from assumptions.

prompt_templates.title: Compare competition across two niches
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: Allocate a limited research budget across two niches.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare packing cubes and travel toiletry bags using PipiAds product, advertiser, and store data. Stay within 20 credits and ask before exceeding that limit. Rank both niches by observed competition and repeated ad activity. Note missing evidence.

output_examples.input: Show an example shortlist for travel organizers.
output: Illustrative result: Compression packing cubes appeared in ads from two advertisers. One ad showed a before-and-after packing demo.
Illustrative result: A hanging toiletry bag appeared in one store listing. The listing did not show a price.
Next step: Verify the advertised price and compare the two packing cube offers. These results do not establish sales.

output_examples.input: Show how a comparison of two competing stores might read.
output: Illustrative result: Store A ran its bundle offer for longer. Store B used the same packing demo in several ad variants.
Interpretation: The offer and demo are worth comparing. Neither signal establishes which store sold more products.

best_practices: Start with a narrow niche and cap results before requesting detail lookups.
Confirm a credit budget before expanding the search, and keep API keys out of prompts.
Compare multiple advertisers and separate observed ad activity from assumptions about sales.
anti_patterns: Treat a long-running ad as proof of profitability.
Request details for every result before reviewing a shortlist.
Use paid ad data as a substitute for organic TikTok or TikTok Shop analytics.

faq.question: What do I need to use this skill?
faq.answer: Configure the PipiAds MCP server in your client and supply your PipiAds API key through its secure configuration.

faq.question: Which ad platforms does it cover?
faq.answer: It uses the TikTok and Facebook ad data available through PipiAds.

faq.question: How are credits used?
faq.answer: The skill lists one credit per search result and one per detail request. A repeated detail lookup within three days is listed as free.

faq.question: Can it tell me whether a product is profitable?
faq.answer: No. Ad activity and listed prices can help you shortlist products, but they do not verify sales, costs, or profit.

faq.question: Can I research a specific competitor?
faq.answer: Yes. Search for the store or advertiser, then retrieve available competition, product activity, and ad history details.

faq.question: Can it monitor competitor ads continuously?
faq.answer: No. This skill focuses on on-demand research rather than scheduled monitoring or alerts.
